{{Quote|Ndigo, welcome aboard. I heard about your bravery on Rirsack. Your tactics were brilliant.|Han Solo to Lars Ndigo|<ref name="ce3.4">[[Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost 4|''Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost'' 4]]</ref>}}
A '''battle''' between the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and an enemy force took place on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rirsack]] during or before [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]]. Due to the bravery<ref name="ce3.1" /> and brilliant tactics<ref name="ce3.4" /> of [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Lar Ndigo]], the New Republic emerged victorious. Ndigo's actions led to his promotion to the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Captain/Legends|captain]] and his subsequent appointment to Republic operations on the planets [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]]<ref name="ce3.1" /> and [[Pallaxides]] under [[General/Legends|General]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]].<ref name="ce3.4" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle was first mentioned in the [[Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost 1|first issue]] of the [[Star Wars: Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost|''Star Wars: Crimson Empire III—Empire Lost'']] series of [[Star Wars comic books|comics]], authored by [[Mike Richardson]] and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="ce3.1" /> on [[October 26]], [[2011]].<ref name="Marvel1">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54051/star_wars_crimson_empire_iii_-_empire_lost_2011_1|text=Star Wars: Crimson Empire III - Empire Lost (2011) #1}}</ref> The [[Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost 4|fourth issue]],<ref name="ce3.4" /> published on [[February 8]], [[2012]],<ref name="Marvel2">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54054/star_wars_crimson_empire_iii_-_empire_lost_2011_4|text=Star Wars: Crimson Empire III - Empire Lost (2011) #4}}</ref> misspells Rirsack as "Rorsack."<ref name="ce3.4" /> [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]] confirms the original spelling as the accurate one.<ref name="TEAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref>
